blocks.text: Bea Millan-Windorski has sealed her spot as one of the perceived frontrunners at the 2026 Miss Universe pageant with a solid performance during the preliminary competition in Puerto Rico. The Filipino-American beauty queen from La Union competed against over 100 other delegates in the swimsuit and evening gown events held at the Coliseo de Puerto Rico Jose Miguel Agrelot in San Juan on Nov. 22 (23 in Manila). During the swimsuit segment where the delegates paraded in swimwear of various shades of blue, Windorski appeared in a dark blue two-piece set with sparkling star details.
